name: Worth Plumbing Budget Pricing
assumptions: Budgetary plumbing estimate built from fixture counts, entered pipe runs, and Worth rule-pack labor units.
Fixtures marked 'by others' are installed only; the fixture price is excluded.
Pipe quantities include the rule-pack waste factor and are rounded up to full sticks or coils for ordering.
exclusions: Excludes engineering, sewer/water tap and impact fees, utility company work, excavation beyond the plumbing trench, concrete cutting and patching, fire protection, and conditions not captured in this takeoff.
